title: Tests and Diagnostics
body: Our bodies are a network of delicate and interconnected systems. An imbalance in these systems can result in serious health concerns, causing physical and mental stress and illness. Identifying the source of your issues is the first step to improving your symptoms and accessing the treatments you need to feel your best.

Using state-of-the-art diagnostic technology, our providers trace the causes of common health concerns, helping patients find answers to conditions that may have been misdiagnosed or overlooked in the past. With one of our comprehensive evaluations, we can recommend an appropriate therapy that matches your individual concerns, identifying effective treatments that can address your issues at the source.

title: IV Therapy
body: Almost everyone is familiar with the vitamins and minerals we get from our food. These vital nutrients are essential elements used by various biological systems to ensure we maintain optimal health and wellbeing. However, we often don’t get enough of these nutrients from our food, or it is poorly absorbed in the GI tract leading to deficiencies that result in fatigue, brain fog, insomnia, weight loss, nervousness, low moods, chronic illness, and other mental and physical health conditions.

IV Therapy is a specialized treatment that delivers these beneficial vitamins directly into your bloodstream, where they can easily be absorbed and utilized, helping patients overcome their deficiencies. From strengthening your immune system to improving your mood and energy levels, intravenous supplementation offers a multitude of health benefits that can be customized to the specific needs of each patient.
By working synergistically with your body, different formulas target different biological systems, addressing your symptoms at the source to improve your overall health.

For patients interested in IV Therapy, we perform a comprehensive evaluation to determine their needs and concerns. Once we’ve identified their issues, we will recommend a customized formula that reflects their biological profile, taking into consideration their lifestyle, vitamin deficiencies, mood, and other factors.

Health-boosting supplements used in IV Therapy include vitamins such as vitamin C, folate, b12, Minerals such as magnesium, zinc, selenium, and amino acids such as glycine, taurine, lysine, arginine, and several others, which can increase energy and mood, improve your immune system, and help your body manage a wide range of other conditions.

Intravenous hydration with or without the nutrients is administered in the clinic setting delivering the formula to the patient’s bloodstream. Procedure takes anywhere from 30 minutes to an hour and a half. Depending on the type of therapy, patients may experience immediate benefits shortly after the infusion or more subtle improvements that will develop over time.
We also offer intramuscular and/or subcutaneous injections when preferable and appropriate.

title: Hormone Balancing
body: Hormones are the messengers your body uses to communicate within itself. These important molecules regulate nearly all of our bodily functions, including our immune system, digestive system monitoring growth, appetite, mood, and libido.

When our hormone levels drop too low, it can disrupt the natural processes in our bodies, leading to many common chronic conditions that impact our ability to function and can decrease our quality of life.
Thankfully, Bioidentical Hormone Replacement Therapy (BHRT) can help those struggling with abnormal hormone levels maintain a balance of their vital bodily functions.

Unlike synthetic hormones, bioidentical hormones are structurally and chemically identical to the body’s hormones, making them a natural and safe option for restoring declining levels of your own natural hormones.

Creating hormonal balance facilitates the body’s ability to regulate and increase mood, energy, appearance, libido, mental acuity and physical health and well being. Sulmuntanious optimizing of ovarian, adrenal, thyroid, pituitary and other hormones supports the entire endocrine system and entire body, not just parts of it.
This makes BHRT a natural and safe treatment for balancing your hormones that can alleviate the symptoms caused when your levels are low or too high.

Hormone balancing is just as important for men’s health as it is for women’s health. Balanced levels of testosterone in conjunction with optimized levels of thyroid, adrenal and digestive hormones will promote healthy levels of energy, sexual health, body composition and mental concentration and acuity.

The first step in hormonal therapy is accurate assessment of your current health status. Typically blood, urine, and or saliva and imaging tests are commonly ordered. Lab analysis, depending on the issue, can be ordered both fasting and postprandial. Frequently, tests done both fasting and after a meal, are needed so as not to miss the intricacies of metabolism of sugars and hormonal reactions to them. It is important for women to consider the day of the menstrual cycle which is carefully selected to make sure that current state female hormone levels are accurate. When the diagnostic work and a thorough medical examination has been performed, a customized treatment plan that considers your lifestyle, diet, exercise, and daily routine will be created.

After your diagnostic evaluation, we will recommend an appropriate formula and dosage that corresponds to your specific issues and areas of concern. Once you begin therapy, we will monitor your progress, ensuring that your hormone levels remain stable, tweaking the dosage as needed.
Results of hormone balancing can vary from patient to patient—while some individuals may respond immediately to treatment, others may require more time before they experience full benefits.
In most cases, it takes from 2 to 4 weeks to start noticing positive changes. Within 2 to 5 months, most patients should experience the full benefits of therapy.

title: Weight Management
body: Managing your weight can be a challenge that many of us are facing. The truth of the matter is, if it were as simple as diet and exercise, every one of us would get into a healthy body weight and stay there by now. Unfortunately, problems with abnormal weight gain and difficulties losing it are almost always rooted in human physiology. Mental and emotional well-being, physical activity, and dietary habits are important factors that should all be taken into consideration as well.

Current obsessive use of an expensive weight loss injectable medication as a single source of weight loss, prescribed blindly and uncontrollably, is not sufficient in addressing the complex issues associated with the weight loss. Use of any single medication has a short lived effect and is destined to result in weight return worse than it was, leaving people frustrated, unhappy and unhealthy.

Modern pharmacological breakthroughs in weight loss have a great value in skilled hands as a great adjunct therapy. Simultaneous correction of many other contributing factors assures that the weight not only comes off, but also stays off after the therapy has been completed. When weight loss is addressed and treated as a complex state of health, the outcome would yield the reversal of unhealthy chronic and debilitating diseases. The goal of successful weight therapy is to reverse risks of chronic diseases and maximize chances of achieving lasting good health.

The most important objective of weight loss therapy is to address and balance the endocrine (HORMONAL) system. Accurate testing to see what is happening in the body during a period of fasting and after eating a meal gives the most precise picture. Most commonly, there is insulin resistance and leptin resistance. Those hormones when elevated drive overeating, night time eating, sugar cravings that a person can not control. It does not matter how much cardio and weight training a person does, until those hormonal problems are addressed, weight will keep coming on.

Often there are several hormonal abnormalities happening all at the same time at different degrees: high leptin, high insulin, suboptimal function of the thyroid gland and or elevated or misfired stress hormones such as cortisol and prolactin, sex hormones when addressed simultaneously, deliver most beneficial and lasting results.

Most common nutritional efficiency is in protein and vitamin D. Right behind are deficiencies in folate, vitamin B12 and iron. We also test trace minerals as they are important co-factors in all of this. Trace minerals are of a huge importance in proper carbohydrate metabolism and thyroid function.
We offer additional supplementation with powerful blends to assist in fighting food cravings, fatigue, anxiousness, low moods, helping the body to burn unwanted fat and build desirable muscle mass.

At the Health and Beauty Integrative Center, we take the most physiological approach to weight management, helping patients improve their overall health through targeted weight management therapies. Common recommendations include improving protein intake, taking vitamins and or medications to address problem areas of energy production needs and efficient hormonal functioning.

We use the most safe and effective dosing of several pharmacological and nutraceutical options. The goal is to achieve a sustainable weight loss process with no or minimal side effects, gain maximum beneficial effects, and keep the weight off for good.

The human body is the most amazing self regulating and regenerating machinery when given a chance. Body’s adaptation abilities are seen with weight loss and change in body composition. After staying at the target weight for about 12 months, all body systems adapt and re-calibrate to function properly at the healthy weight and it becomes natural to maintain this healthy weight going forward. Normalizing body weight greatly affects the cardiovascular system, gastrointestinal system, function of the kidneys and the liver. It is realistic to greatly decrease the number and or dosages of medications that the person was on prior to losing the weight. Often there is no need for blood pressure, colesterol, diabetic medications, pain relievers etc.

In fact, body weight has far-reaching effects on your health. Obesity is a major cause of inflammation and chronic diseases such as diabetes, heart disease, autoimmune spectrum diseases, and even cancers. It is of paramount importance to keep healthy body weight to lower risks of developing debilitating diseases.

Fortunately, many of these symptoms can easily be reduced or eliminated through weight loss management, without the need for expensive surgeries. Losing as little as 5% of your total weight can be enough to promote unbelievable changes that can help treat these conditions.

title: Nutrition Analysis and Detox
body: Proper nutrition is key to preventing many diseases.
Nutrients are necessary to feed every cell and ensure all body systems are functioning properly.
Many common chronic conditions have a primary nutritional and/or toxin imbalance as a root cause.

Rather than a one-size-fits-all approach to diet and nutritional supplementation, functional medicine offers a tailored approach to address your individual metabolic needs. Testing can help gain an understanding of how nutritional imbalances may be impacting your health.

According to Genova Laboratories, “There are various methods of assessing nutrient status, including intracellular and extracellular direct measurements, and measuring biological pathway markers that require specific nutrient cofactors for proper metabolism”.
That is why at Health and Beauty Integrative Center – we utilize micronutrient nutritional analysis to gain a complete picture of one’s metabolism, nutrient, and mineral deficiencies, and imbalances.
Knowing this information, many issues could be solved or prevented with precise dosing of appropriate vitamins, minerals, amino acids, antioxidants, and fatty acids.
This information can also lead to precise, individualized nutritional planning and supplementation.

title: Pelvic Floor Therapies
body: Pelvic Floor Muscle Rehabilitation (Pelvic Floor Therapy/ PFMR) is a non-surgical treatment used to increase bladder and bowel control in men and women by strengthening the surrounding muscles.

Combining a personalized home program with in-office therapy, treatment helps individuals regulate their bladders and bowels, giving them more control throughout the day, with fewer trips to the bathroom as well as improved sexual function ( in women).

During your Pelvic Floor evaluation, we assess the condition of the muscles around your bladder to create a personalized care plan to strengthen them, incorporating electro-stimulation of the pelvic floor nerves, muscles, and tissues.

The Pelvic Floor consists of muscles that form a sling from the pubic bone to the tailbone. These muscles provide bladder and bowel control, and are responsible for anatomical positioning of inner organs in your lower pelvis.

With age or certain health conditions, these muscles begin to lose strength, elasticity, and flexibility. As a result, patients develop symptoms known as incontinence, which causes the bladder to leak urine at inopportune moments on the way to the bathroom or at random times, more so during laughing, sneezing, coughing, jumping. Same etiology is also true in poor bowel control.

Individuals afflicted with weak pelvic floor muscles also complain of a strong and sudden urge to urinate or have a bowel movement but can’t get to the bathroom quick enough. For patients who experience symptoms of Overactive bladder, bowel urgency, night time frequency , Pelvic Floor Therapy helps to strengthen the surrounding muscle fibers and tissues, which restricts and prevents the uncontrolled release of urine and the bowels.

At the Health and Beauty Integrative Center, we personalize therapy to match the individual needs of each patient, targeting specific muscles around the bladder and bowel to improve urinary and bowel function as well as sexual health.
